messages:
Alex: Heads-up — aiming to finalize the release notes and internal announcement for tomorrow's canary. Change window target: 05:00 PT. Need a short blurb + pinning/rollback bullets.
Maya: sounds good, I can draft the blurb. timeline ok for me.
Elena: ops ok with 04:30-06:30 PT window (covers warmup + verification). tagging oncall.
Ravi: I'll handle the model pinning and router config. will post checksum when done.
Alex: Draft blurb (WIP):
> We're rolling out runtime perf and stability improvements to the inference serving stack. Expected outcome: ~10-15% reduction in median latency for short-chat workloads and improved batching efficiency. No API surface changes. No model weight changes. If you see regressions, please notify #support and page oncall.
Maya: tiny wording suggestion: add "No model weight changes" explicitly so SRE/customer folks don't worry about output diffs. also add contact links.
Elena: +1 add contact and the oncall handle. Also call out the fallback plan briefly.
Alex: OK incorporated. Ravi, what's the pin/fallback plan?
Ravi: Plan: pin hosted routing to llm-open-v1.9.0, fallback to v1.8.7. Rollout via canary in us-west-2 (3 nodes) then ramp. Rollback trigger: error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m or latency regresses by >25% p50.
Ravi: executing canary now...
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: release/2026-03-runtime-v1.9.0 -> us-west-2 (3 hosts)
deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded: all health checks passed
Sergio: ran a quick smoke with typical prompt sets — p50 latency down ~12% and no diffs in token outputs for our eval set. uploading graphs to the canary folder.
Maya: drafting internal announcement; will wait for the pin checksum and a quick sign-off. aiming to post to #product and #eng right after canary pass (around 05:30 PT).
Alex: add these rollout bullets to the blurb: canary region, pin details, rollback triggers, who to contact. keep it short.
Ravi: pin applied to routing. snippet:
```
routing:
  pinned_model: "llm-open-v1.9.0"
  fallback_model: "llm-open-v1.8.7"
```
Ravi: checksum: a1b2c3d4
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: latency p50 -12%, error_rate 0.02% (baseline 0.015%)
Maya: final copy below — waiting 10m for objections, then I'll send internal post:
> Quick internal note: We're deploying runtime improvements (no API or model weight changes) that reduce median latency by ~10-15% for short chats and improve batching. Canary completed in us-west-2. Hosted routing pinned to llm-open-v1.9.0 with fallback to v1.8.7. Rollback triggers: >0.5% error rate for 5m or >25% p50 latency regression. If you see any customer impact, please raise in #support and page oncall.
Elena: no objections from ops. Go ahead.
Sergio: LGTM :thumbsup:
Maya: posted to #product and #eng (05:31 PT). tagging oncall + support.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Ravi — keep an eye on metrics during the ramp and ping if anything looks off.
Ravi: will monitor, set a short dashboard alert.
Maya: closing thread here; will keep a follow-up with release notes link once the public doc is updated.
Alex: great, thanks team!
